notes.title: Patch v0.13.0
notes.content:
[b]This update mainly focuses on these things:[/b]

[list]
[*] Network rewrite - Reducing input lag.
[*] In-game progression.
[*] Rework of the sword class.
[*] A final tiebreaker game round.
[*] New introduction tutorial.
[/list]

But it also contains tons of minor fixes, changes and bugs! Alright, let's dive into it!

[h2]Network update - Reducing input lag[/h2]

We have completely rewritten the underlying network system. The result of this is mainly reduced input lag which means that the game is now more responsive to your input. With this in place we will now be able to extend the weapon classes with more timed abilities which in turn will open up for more skilled plays. Something that was impossible with our previous system.

This rewrite of the underlying code did break almost all aspects of the gameplay, and we have spent a lot of time to get back to where we were before. But now, we are finally back enough to release an update even though we still have a lot to catch up to.

[h2]In-game progression[/h2]

We have added an in-game progression system where you collect gems in each round which you then can buy boosters with, such as increased speed and health. You get these gems by killing opponents or by finding them on the map.

[h2]Sword class rewrite[/h2]

We have completely changed how the sword is handled. Thanks to the network rewrite you can now do smaller and more placed swings. We haven't had the time to add any animations to him yet. So he looks a bit jerky. But we are working on it!

[h2]Tiebreaker game round[/h2]

We have added a final game round, which takes place as a tiebreaker to make sure that only one team wins. Watch out for the enclosing circle!

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

The practice room is currently replaced with a new tutorial level which all new players will play to learn the game a bit easier. This new training level has bots, so you are not stuck to fight those stationary dummies anymore.

[h1]Onward[/h1]

This update took a while, probably way to long. But we know that we now will be able to release updates more frequently than ever before.

See you in the arena!

notes.title: Fightworld is coming to Steam Early Access
notes.content:
[h1]
Release date: October 9, 15:00 GMT / 8 am PDT [/h1]
That's right, we are releasing the game in just a week! And we are super excited to finally let you play the game that we have been working super hard on.

[h2]Why early access?[/h2]
We realized that we had a long way to go before the game would be done. And being a small indie team trying to figure out what actually is fun proved to be harder and harder. By opening the gates to the game before it is done we hope that we can start an open dialogue with you the community and shape the game to something greater together.

In the meantime, join our [url=https://discord.gg/rapFR4F]Discord server[/url] before the release to get in-game coins for FREE! And make sure to add Fightworld to your wishlist if you haven't done so already!

See you in the arena!

- Rekt Games

notes.title: Complete website & Steam page Rehaul coming up!
notes.content:
[h1]Complete website & Steam page Rehaul coming up!
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34041141/7534e2b7fc01b696240bcbc4576392cb59be2a44.png[/img]

First of all, we've been pretty bad with giving out updates and such lately. however, we're intending on changing that. Moving further, we'll give you more consistent updates with a solid foundation of something fun that has been added to the current state of the game, so you can be just as excited as we are!

So, now to the current news. Both our website and the Steam page is pretty much oudated. We've made a ton of new updates to the core gameplay as well as the general feel of the game, and soon we'll be publishing Fightworld in its new look.

In the screenshot attached, you can see a glimpse of what the new Fightworld will look like. This is a screenshot dump from the upcoming Fightworld website.

But, you've come all the way here to read something new about the game, so we'll give you a treat:

In Fightworld, we had the thought "Okay, we're swinging, but what's next?". We intended to fix this, and what's currently implemented is the following:
[h3]COMBO POINTS[/h3]
Hit enemies a set amount of times, without taking damage, to unlock new abilites! How about, you can kick an enemy REALLY HARD out of the platform? Or...

Okay, that's enough of a treat, we'll let you know more in the future!

//REKT GAMES
